title: Mr. Bean Hidden Objects
description: Today in this game your task is to help the funny Mr. Bean to find the hidden objects. After entering one of the levels you have to find all the hidden objects. The names of the items you need to find will appear on the left side. You need to concentrate well and find all the objects. You have to watch the time, because if it runs out it will be game over. Try to get the maximum points and three stars in every level.
instructions: Click with your mouse or tap on the screen to find the objects
